records.body: Is there a way to bulk-import contacts from a spreadsheet instead of adding them one at a time?

records.subject: Re: Bulk import
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Following up on this one. Yes -- teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad
Does the API support pagination for the accounts endpoint, or do we need to fetch everything at once?

records.subject: Re: API pagination
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for your patience on this. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the update — good to hear getting everyone set up is on this week's list. On your API question: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you don't need to fetch everything at once. Tariq is still working both your open tickets, including the notification badge, and will follow up there.

One thing that may speed up the rollout: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. Want me to walk through that first invite with you this week?

Best,
Chidi
